session_summary: Completed the introductory Moss Trail route from step 0 to step 12. Encountered three routine enemy fights (Goblin, Slime, Kobold) spaced along the walk actions, finishing the route cleanly with full HP (100) and earning 25 coins.

observations.evidence: Play trace shows starting directly on 'moss' route without introductory context or tooltips explaining the walk/fight loop.
observations.recommendation: Introduce welcome tooltips at step 0 to explain basic movement and combat mechanics for first-time players.

observations.evidence: Completed Moss Trail easily with 3 enemy encounters and a straightforward sequence of walk steps.
observations.recommendation: Keep the Moss Trail difficulty gentle, but ensure a clearer route preview is available before selection.

feature_requests.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players understand initial movement and combat mechanics without guessing.
feature_requests.rationale: First-session telemetry indicates players are dropped right into routes without guidance at step 0.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Display clear, friendly introductory guidance and UI callouts during the first few steps of the initial route.

keep: Moss Trail starting route difficulty and pacing are appropriate for a first-time player session.
Straightforward step-by-step movement tracking makes progress easy to follow.
focus: onboarding, clarity, route choice, controls, first-session friction
